run_make_lmdb_sizes: run the script to generate metadata.npz files for load balancing a DataLoader from an LMDB dataset
run_get_lmdb_sizes_parser: run the argument parser to configure data-path and num-workers for LMDB size generation
run_get_data: run the get_data function to extract natoms and neighbor counts from a dataset index
refactor_make_lmdb_sizes: refactor make_lmdb_sizes to support additional dataset types beyond LMDB for metadata generation
review_make_lmdb_sizes: review the make_lmdb_sizes function and its multiprocessing pool usage for LMDB dataset size extraction
